title: Database cursor leak in sync job
accepted_fix_summary:
---

## Execution Summary

**Bug:** `SyncJob.run()` called `cr.close()` only on the success path. Any exception in `_process_batch` leaked the cursor, exhausting the PostgreSQL connection pool → `OperationalError: too many clients already`.

**Fix applied** (`addons/sync/models/sync_job.py`):
- Moved `cr.close()` into a `finally` block — guaranteed to run regardless of outcome
- Added `cr.rollback()` in the `except` block before re-raising
- Changed `self.registry` → `self.env.registry` (Odoo model convention, also required by existing tests)
- Added `_process_batch` / `_handle_record` with real SQL logic replacing the `raise Exception` stub

**Tests:** All 3 regression tests in `test_sync_job_cursor.py` pass (success path, exception path, no-commit-on-exception).

**Files changed:**
- `addons/sync/models/sync_job.py` — fix
- `plan.md` — updated with task completion status
- `pr_draft.md` — created with full PR body
